declarations.docstring: Provides auxiliary data with prescribed degree-zero and degree-one equivalences and triviality in all higher displayed degrees.
Shows that the displayed component in every degree offset by two has at most one element.
Constructs the displayed degree-one additive equivalence when every listed element on both sides is nonzero.
Constructs the displayed degree-zero additive equivalence indexed by the two supplied data objects.
The auxiliary isomorphism from the displayed component to the quotient by the ideal generated by its indexed element.
The auxiliary linear equivalence from the displayed carrier to the quotient by the ideal generated by its indexed element.
